newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwe police teargas students to stop protests.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe police teargas students to stop protests.

text.p: Zimbabwean police fired teargas on Thursday to disperse university students who were planning to march into the city centre to protest against delays in state allowances.
Students and lecturers scrambled from lecture halls, most of them coughing and choking, as teargas from cannisters thrown by police onto the university campus billowed out of buildings.
About 50 riot control police sealed off the Harare campus to stop the students from marching into the city centre.
Two weeks ago students demonstrated peacefully in the city centre against the introduction of tuition fees and alleged corruption in President Robert Mugabe's government.
